name: compact
about: The phone map, normalised to the street band under the CTAs (Hero.css .hero__streets), not the whole hero. The band starts 48px below the CTAs and nothing crosses its top edge, so the headline clearance holds by construction. It has to work from a 320x240 band to a 767x430 one. A main road runs across the top and another across the lower right; four streets come down at uneven spacing, two of them stopping at a junction rather than running through, so the grid jogs. Side streets: a short one on the left, and one that becomes a main road where it crosses the lower road.
